Matthew Cox presents a real-life Breaking Bad case in episode 48 of the KONCRETE podcast with Danny Jones. The case involves a chemistry expert who turned his knowledge to making drugs, echoing the famous TV story. Cox, who knows the criminal world firsthand, narrates how fact outdid fiction.

Cox lays out the man's path from the lab to the kingpin life and the manhunt that followed. He compares the real choices and consequences with the show's version. Jones asks what drives a trained mind to that edge. Stunned and curious listeners get a wild ride through a case stranger than its TV twin.

Researcher Mike Benz joins Tucker Carlson to argue that aid groups serve as spy tools. He mocks names like the United States Institute of Peace. Such groups, he says, often do the opposite of their names.

Benz points to protests where crowds demand to stay blind to foreign funding. The title warns that a favorite charity may be a CIA weapon. He traces money from agencies into groups that shape other nations. Carlson follows the trail with him. The episode asks donors to ask who truly pays for the causes they fund.
